page.layout: One printed page of running text in a single column, with marginal numbers and partly hidden side notes at the right edge; a narrow strip of the facing page is visible at the far right and is not transcribed.
page.running_head: Cap. 4. de præf. reali corp. Christi.

main_text.l: cibus & potus spiritualis: negamus posse ore
Dices: si corpus Christi est verum
corpus, ergo necesse est ut modo corporali
cognoscitur prout est in se ipso: ut
corpus Christi corpus est, non spiritus: ergo
corporeo, non spirituali modo percipiatur necessario.
Sed distinguendum est inter rem ipsam
etiam post glorificationem: id vero non
impedit, quo minus modus participationis sit
docent, eo ipso loco agi de spirituali
ejus corporis manducatione. Itaque fieri recte potest, & est
Christi substantia spiritualiter, vere tamen non imaginarie, à nobis vera fide percipiatur & manducetur.

page.notes: Right margin fragments are cut off and partly illegible; the marginal notes at the right edge are hidden by the binding and show only partial words. Several words in the margin overlap the text and are not transcribed. Scan damaged along the right edge; some words such as "potus" and "fide" are uncertain.
